summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' challenge at START Hack Munich: analyse Soony's confidential launch data, then build the alert agent (watcher, supplier mail, phone/voice calls, PWA push, voice assistant with tools) as part of a team product.
summary.outcome: Found the real launch risks (Collector's Edition short on art books and statues, game cards ~6,800 short, magnets a false alarm) and built a polling/versioned-store watcher, Gmail supplier mail, Twilio and OpenAI Realtime alert calls, and a PWA voice inbox with cookie login, real verifier cards and send/escalate tools. Everything is committed locally on three branches and nothing is pushed; hold-to-talk was just removed and phone tests are still pending.

repo: Challenge data is confidential: keep it in gitignored data/, never commit it, and never copy values into code, tests or docs; use example.com placeholders.
Project CLAUDE.md rules: no em dashes, commit on your own with one commit per topic, no attribution trailers, author josteng, and ask before every push or PR.

The Lio portal API has only GET /api/v1/files (with sha256), /files/{path} and /archive.zip. There are no webhooks or notifications, so polling with SHA-256 diffing is the intended approach. Files are replaced under the same name, and new drops arrive without notice.

Dashboard inbox shows Akshat's sample fixture unless a module writes real cards to data/store/*cards*.json. The verifier on origin/integration/verifier can generate real cards with to_email from portal data.

The tmux serve session runs code loaded from jonas/alerts, but the working tree is jonas/voice-dashboard (based on akshat/dashboard) and lacks alerts and openai_calls. Restarting serve from this checkout would break the call webhooks.
Twilio trial accounts accept only Url-mode calls (no inline Twiml) and need verified numbers. German numbers need a business regulatory bundle, so a US number was used.

OpenAI Realtime SIP needs a project-level webhook (realtime.call.incoming, not the org page), then accept the call and attach a sideband WebSocket. Noise handling used server_vad threshold 0.8, near_field noise reduction, interrupt_response false and English-only transcription.

iOS home screen PWAs do not show the basic-auth dialog or keep that login, so a blank white page appears on reopen. A cookie-based /login with 30-day expiry fixed it. The manifest link needs crossorigin=use-credentials if it sits behind auth.
Static PWA files (manifest, sw.js, icons) must be exempt from auth for iOS to install and request push.

code.finding: Middleware is active only if ASK_DASHBOARD_PASSWORD is in the process env at startup (not from .env) so Akshat's tests stay open. It now has /login with a 30-day cookie, a next-URL redirect guard and a manually parsed form body.

Voice assistant tools get_card_details, send_supplier_email and escalate_to. Mail only sends the pre-written draft, after confirmed:true, only to the 6 portal-profile supplier addresses, and not while a dashboard edit is pending.
WebRTC voice with an ordered transcript, where a placeholder line is filled in place. Hold-to-talk was added then removed at the user's request; hands-free with English-only transcription is kept.
Web Push with a VAPID key in data/state/vapid_private.pem and subscriptions in push_subscriptions.json. Routes are /api/push/key, /subscribe and /test, and the 404/410 subscriptions are dropped.

workflow: Check for an existing team workflow (CLAUDE.md, PROGRESS.md, branches) before writing code, and avoid editing teammates' files without telling them.
Do not take paid actions such as buying phone numbers without asking, including automatic fallbacks; the user objected when a US number was bought automatically.
Make outbound alert emails opt-in; a real email was once sent accidentally to a personal address during testing.
Mask phone numbers, and never print API keys or secrets or copy credentials pasted in chat into docs.
Voice UX should feel like a phone call: the user rejected a walkie-talkie style hold-to-talk design.
Use a subagent to cross-check hundreds of documents (200 order confirmations, 59 scans) against SAP data; it found the 80,000 vs 8,000 art-book overbooking.
Before compaction, persist state to the project memory dir (ask-soony-status.md, ask-before-spending.md) rather than a teammate's PROGRESS.md.

friction: Portal returned 401 until the token was set, and early baseline polls timed out.
Cloudflare tunnel setup: the hostname attached to another tunnel via the default config, second-level subdomain certs failed, and QUIC was blocked (fixed with http2).
Twilio trial and compliance limits (verification calls, shared number, German regulatory bundle, KYC) cost a lot of time.
OpenAI Realtime calls had noise problems: cancelled turns, background chatter answered, and a stuck 'getting connected' announcement; tuned several times.
The PWA notification permission dialog did not appear and the app showed a blank page on reopen because of basic auth.
Card details are hidden far down the list on phones, which confused the user.
Background voices were transcribed as Chinese characters, the transcript order was wrong, and sample cards used an unusable example.com address.
GitHub was unreachable for a while, so overnight work stayed unpushed.
open_items: Push jonas/alerts (5 commits), jonas/voice-dashboard and the supplier-status spec after the user's explicit OK, and tell Akshat about the voice-dashboard branch.
Test the PWA login, push alerts, English transcription and transcript order on a real iPhone; verify that the removal of hold-to-talk built and committed.
Hook critical alerts automatically to push.send and to the Twilio/ElevenLabs call escalation.
Possibly add a revise_draft tool so the draft can be changed during the call, with a second yes before sending.
Resolve whether a separate sender module reads decisions.json, to avoid duplicate sends, and whether supplier mail for the Nowak art-book order (24 h offer) has been approved and sent.
Move the Enable call alerts button to the app top bar and scroll to details on tap (touches Akshat's files).
Restore the tmux serve session to a branch that has the alerts and openai_calls code before restarting.
Hand-in items for Sun 12:00: deployed prototype, deck, video of at most 3 minutes, README; confirm whether the earlier Claude doc should be deleted.
Open question: whether portal data and the effects of sent mails are the same for all teams.
